title: Terraform/IaC Engineer
description: Automate multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning safely and deterministically using Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, and Policy as Code.

goal.objective: Manage enterprise infrastructure as declarative, version-controlled code, ensuring repeatable, auditable, and automated cloud deployments.

learn.summary: Master HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL), remote state management, state locking, reusable modules, Terragrunt DRY architecture, and drift detection.
key_competencies: HCL Syntax, Loops, Dynamic Blocks & Functions
Policy as Code with Open Policy Agent (OPA)
prerequisites: Basic understanding of at least one cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP)

capstone_projects.title: Reusable Enterprise Multi-Cloud Terraform Module Library with Terratest
capstone_projects.description: Develop an enterprise-grade library of hardened Terraform modules provisioning VPCs, EKS clusters, and RDS databases with automated Terratest validation in CI.

capstone_projects.title: Zero-Downtime Infrastructure Drift Detection & Auto-Remediation Engine
capstone_projects.description: Engineer an automated drift monitoring workflow checking cloud state every 6 hours, calculating pull request cost impact with Infracost, and alerting engineers.

interview_focus: Terraform State Management, Locking Mechanisms & Remote State Storage in S3/DynamoDB
Terraform Module Architecture, Input Validation Rules & Output Design
Managing State Migrations, Imports & Refactoring (terraform state mv, import blocks)
Infrastructure Testing Strategies (Static Analysis with TFLint/Checkov vs Terratest Integration)
Terraform Workspaces vs Directory-Based Multi-Environment Separation (Terragrunt)

tree.name: Foundations and Role Context
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable Infrastructure as Code foundation: declarative state modeling, immutable infrastructure paradigms, directed acyclic graph (DAG) dependency resolution, and disciplined Git collaboration.

resources.title: Terraform Crash Course for Absolute Beginners | Learn Infrastructure as Code (Kubesimplify)

children.name: IaC Principles & Terraform Introduction
children.description: Master the fundamentals of Infrastructure as Code: declarative vs imperative provisioning, idempotency guarantees, the infrastructure lifecycle (init, plan, apply, destroy), the Terraform core engine (provider plugins, schema generation, and resource dependency graph construction), and understanding configuration drift.

resources.title: What is Infrastructure as Code (IaC)? (TechWorld with Nana)
Terraform Explained in 15 Mins (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Terraform CLI Essentials & Git Workflow
children.description: Master the Terraform CLI and Git workflows: configuring variable precedence (CLI flags, `.tfvars` files, environment variables `TF_VAR_`), selective targeting (`-target`) and its dangers, JSON output parsing, enforcing code formatting with `terraform fmt -check`, `terraform validate`, and establishing trunk-based development with automated pre-commit hooks.

resources.title: Terraform Course - Automate Your AWS Cloud Infrastructure (freeCodeCamp.org)
Complete Terraform Course - From Beginner to Pro (DevOps Directive)

tree.name: Core Skills and Implementation
tree.description: Master production Terraform engineering: advanced HCL2 language features, enterprise remote state management, and automated unit/integration testing frameworks.

resources.title: Terraform for Beginners: AWS Infrastructure as Code (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: HCL Language Features & Terraform Modules
children.description: Master advanced HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL2): dynamic blocks, iterating with `for_each` over sets and maps (avoiding brittle index shifting from `count`), splat expressions, ternary conditionals, custom variable validation rules with descriptive error messages, and designing modular, reusable, and composable Terraform modules following standard repository structure.

resources.title: Terraform Modules Tutorial - How to Create and Use (KodeKloud)
Complete Terraform Course - From BEGINNER to PRO! (Learn Infrastructure as Code) (DevOps Directive)

children.name: Terraform State Management
children.description: Master enterprise Terraform state architecture: configuring remote backends (AWS S3 with DynamoDB state locking, Azure Blob Storage with leases, GCP Cloud Storage), inspecting state with `terraform state list/show`, safely refactoring resources with `terraform state mv` and `terraform state rm`, modern declarative resource importing with `import` blocks (Terraform 1.5+), and disaster recovery for corrupted state files.

resources.title: Complete Terraform Course - From BEGINNER to PRO! (Learn Infrastructure as Code) (DevOps Directive)
Terraform Tutorial for Beginners + Labs: Complete Step by Step Guide! (KodeKloud)

children.name: IaC Testing, Validation & Compliance
children.description: Implement rigorous automated testing and compliance guardrails: writing unit and integration tests with the native `terraform test` framework (mocking providers, creating synthetic run blocks, and asserting output values), static analysis with `tflint`, security scanning with `checkov` / `tfsec`, and enforcing policy-as-code guardrails using Open Policy Agent (OPA/Rego) or HashiCorp Sentinel.

resources.title: Terraform Testing and Validation - tfsec, Checkov, Sentinel (DevOps Toolkit)
Introduction to Sentinel, HashiCorp Policy as Code Framework (HashiCorp, an IBM Company)
Introduction to Policy as Code with Sentinel
tfsec - Static analysis security scanner for your Terraform code

tree.name: Production, Collaboration, and Operations
tree.description: Orchestrate enterprise IaC operations: automated CI/CD execution pipelines, secure secrets lifecycles, multi-cloud architectures, and enterprise platform governance.

resources.title: Learn Terraform with Google Cloud Platform - Infrastructure as Code Course (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Automated CI/CD for Terraform Pipelines
children.description: Build enterprise GitOps pipelines for Terraform: automated pull request plan generation using Atlantis or GitHub Actions, posting speculative plan diffs to PR comments, concurrency locks to prevent overlapping applies, and automated execution on branch merge.

resources.title: DevOps Crash Course (Docker, Terraform, and Github Actions) (Traversy Media)

children.name: Secure & Reliable IaC with Secrets Management
children.description: Master zero-trust secrets management in Terraform: eliminating hard-coded and plaintext secrets from state files, masking sensitive variables (`sensitive = true`), integrating with HashiCorp Vault for dynamic short-lived cloud credentials, and integrating cloud secrets managers.

resources.title: HashiCorp Vault + Terraform: The Ultimate Secrets Management Guide (KodeKloud)
8 Terraform Best Practices that will improve your TF workflow immediately (TechWorld with Nana)
Secrets Management with Terraform and Vault

children.name: Multi-Cloud & Hybrid Cloud IaC Patterns
children.description: Design scalable multi-cloud and multi-region infrastructure: abstracting provider implementations across AWS, Azure, and GCP, managing multiple provider instances with provider aliases, cross-stack parameter sharing with `terraform_remote_state` data sources, and maintaining environment parity across dev, staging, and production.

resources.title: Multi-Cloud Foundations with Terraform (HashiCorp, an IBM Company)
Multi-Cloud Foundations with Terraform (HashiCorp, an IBM Company)
Working with Multiple Cloud Providers in Terraform

children.name: Terraform Cloud/Enterprise Operations
children.description: Operate enterprise platforms with HCP Terraform (Terraform Cloud) / Terraform Enterprise: workspace management and RBAC, VCS-driven execution runs, private module registries, automated speculative plans, run tasks, and cloud spend cost estimation.

resources.title: Getting into Terraform, Part 1: Introduction (HashiCorp, an IBM Company)
Cloud Compliance & Management with Terraform - Understanding Workspaces and Sentinel Policy as Code (HashiCorp, an IBM Company)

tree.name: Portfolio and Career Readiness
tree.description: Demonstrate Infrastructure as Code mastery: author production-grade modular landing zones, write technical case studies, and excel in HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate exams and technical systems interviews.

resources.title: How to Get a DevOps/Cloud Engineer Job in 2024 (TechWorld with Nana)
Terraform Associate Certification - Full Study Guide (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Technical Case Study Creation
children.description: Author an IaC Engineering Case Study: document a zero-downtime migration of a complex enterprise cloud footprint from manual console configurations to fully automated Terraform modules, detailing state drift remediation, security policy enforcement, and operational efficiency gains.

resources.title: How I’d Build a Killer DevOps Portfolio in 2025 (KodeKloud)
How to Write a Technical Case Study

children.name: Project: Terraform/IaC Engineer Portfolio Capstone
children.description: Capstone Project: Architect and Deploy an Enterprise Multi-Cloud Landing Zone with Terraform: modular root and child modules for AWS/Azure, remote backend with state locking, native `terraform test` integration tests, automated Atlantis PR workflow, Checkov security compliance gates, and dynamic Vault credential rotation.

resources.title: Build a Real Terraform Project from Scratch - Full Course (DevOps Directive)
Learn Terraform (and AWS) by Building a Dev Environment – Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)
Build an AWS Infrastructure Project (HashiCorp Terraform Tutorials)
